units.source_text: 回进寺里，随从人禀告：“天色不早了，疟疾看来已经痊愈。

en.t: When they returned to the temple, the attendants reported, "It is getting late, and the malaria seems to have already cleared up.
Please set out soon and return to the capital."

units.source_text: 但那老僧劝道：“恐有妖魔附缠贵体，

en.t: But the old monk advised him, "I fear that some demon may still be clinging to your noble body.

units.source_text: 最好今夜再静静地在此诵经祈祷一番，明天回驾，如何？”

en.t: It would be best to remain quietly here tonight and have the sutras recited and prayers offered once more, then return tomorrow. What do you think?"

units.source_text: 随从人都说：“这话说得是。”

en.t: All the attendants said, "That is well said."

units.source_text: 源氏公子自己也觉得这种旅宿难得经验到，颇感兴味，

en.t: Prince Genji himself also felt that this kind of lodging on a journey was a rare experience, and found it rather interesting,

units.source_text: 便说：“那么明天一早动身吧。”

en.t: so he said, "Then let us leave early tomorrow morning."
